with_skill: 4/4 on all three evals — executor reliably reproduced judging-mode switch, hero row y=100/label y=20, zone label convention, gutter values, provenance discipline with DECISION-LOG.md row ranges

Eval 2 expectations were tightened after the original baseline passed two general-knowledge checks: the generic Pages URL and README-link checks were replaced with the deployment-skill exact-URL rule and the three-step post-merge sync discipline.

Targeted live eval-2 rerun against v1.0.1: with_skill 4/4; without_skill 1/4. The baseline retained only the Vite base-path check and missed both new anchors plus the okhp3-vite-github-pages conjunct.

without_skill: evals 1 and 3 scored 0/4 — canvas API (focusCanvasShapes, iframe state) and session handoff conventions (one-page limit, four-section structure, provenance discipline) are entirely skill-specific
Strict recomputation after replacing eval-2: without_skill mean 0.0833 and delta +0.9167.
Phase 7 body fix not required: with_skill mean remains 1.0; this was an expectation-discrimination repair.
